items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: We were all in music together... Pat and John and I are all Eagle Scouts... I think it was more of that, Monk, because we as a family did everything together.

ctx.x: Your motivation when you were nine or ten was jumpstarted by your father and your brothers. Did your father try to instill some of that reality in you or was it sort of like just a way for the family to be together?

I think it was more of that, Monk, because we as a family did everything together. We were all in music together, we were all in scouting together, and because of that involvement, Pat and John and I are all Eagle Scouts, because my parents were involved in everything that we do, right? So I believe it was more about the family community, the family commitment, and also at that age someone might say I want to be the president or a fireman or whatever, you know, and of course you’re allowed to say that. But as it…
